note: Shrink-only. ruleDebt is rules the runtime implements itself; it is zero (see docs/RULE-DEBT.md). unusedRules is verified app-facet rules no command reaches: none. Every game kind the facet can decide is asked by a command: wait (0), move (1), transfer (2), speak (4), clearance (6), identity (7). Kind 8 is the publisher admission, asked by tools/publish.mjs and replayed against the model by the gate.
